parsed_json.sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, m.substrate_record_id, m.metabolite_record_id, cr_sub.compound_key AS substrate_compound_key, cr_met.compound_key AS metabolite_compound_key, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key FROM metabolism m INNER JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_met ON m.metabolite_record_id = cr_met.record_id LIMIT 200
